announcements.title: Help shape what comes next
announcements.body: I’d love to hear how the Companion is getting on in your corner of the galaxy. What’s been useful, what’s a bit clunky, and what do you keep wishing it could do? This is a small project, and hearing about your campaigns helps me work out what to build next.

announcements.title: Stellaris Companion 0.8.0 is ready
announcements.body: Version 0.8.0 adds MCP Relay for Claude Desktop and local AI apps, stretches free Gemini Advisor usage with Flash-Lite routing, adds new interface languages, and updates Advisor guidance for Stellaris 4.3.

announcements.title: Windows Fix: Background Console Window
announcements.body: Version 0.6.3 fixes the background console window issue on Windows. If you still run into anything odd, please send a quick report through the feedback form so we can follow up.

announcements.title: Important for Windows Users: Reinstall Needed
announcements.body: If you’re on Windows, please grab this update from our downloads page instead of in-app update. It’s a quick one-time reinstall to get everything back on track.

announcements.title: New Themes + Gemini Free-Tier Improvements
announcements.body: New color themes are now live in the Settings tab. Huge thanks to u/PrimarchsWrath for the suggestion. We also improved Gemini efficiency so free-tier usage stretches further.
